name: slopscore
description: SlopScore: a deterministic linter for AI-writing patterns in prose, as an agent skill plus MCP server.

plugins.name: slopscore
plugins.description: Find AI-writing patterns ("AI slop") in prose: not-X-but-Y contrasts, dramatic closers, chatbot leftovers, stock vocabulary, em-dash overuse. Deterministic linter, not an AI detector. Adds the slopscore agent skill and the SlopScore MCP server (slop_check and slop_patterns are free; slop_check_long needs Pro).
